authority: The owner explicitly selected keeping local commits only in response to the concrete publication question for this iteration.
scope: This development-foundation iteration and its dependency repair remain local until the owner changes this direction. This takes precedence over earlier default task-branch publication authorization for this work.
allowed: Local implementation, verification, review and recoverable commits.
Read-only inspection of existing remote state.
not_authorized: Push these iteration commits to any remote.
Write the iteration changes to a remote PR or trigger hosted CI for them.
resume_condition: Explicit owner authorization changing the local-only direction; do not ask repeatedly during local work.
verification_boundary: Local applicable checks passed; native Windows evidence for these inputs is unavailable. Do not mark tasks complete without their required checks.
